summary: Describes how to use a SAML 2.0 bearer assertion with OAuth 2.0, both to request an access token and to authenticate a client. It is a profile of the assertion framework in RFC 7521, tying existing SAML-based identity systems to OAuth.

eli5.summary: A big company already hands out signed badges in one format. This document explains how a different website can accept that kind of badge and give you a visitor pass in exchange.

questions: use saml to get an oauth access token
